title: Coral and the Spire
author: Ulyana Zhou
blurb: Cyrus Eastwick, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
